Flow.description:
Add to Inventory for a selected product - can set as Ordered or Inventory
2026-08-14: BN- Flip to run in system mode to allow users w/o delete capability on Asset to successfully run flow 2026-08-31: AP - Capture serial numbers at intake. Scanner and Laptop products now show a per-unit Repeater (scannerSerialEntry) with a required Serial Number instead of a quantity box; quantity is derived from the row count via effectiveQuantity, so a count mismatch is not possible. Serials are stamped onto the created assets in a single Record Update after AddAssetInventory returns, filtered to the main product so bundle accessories are not serialised. Laptops are no longer created by the Received bundle - they are received separately and selected at assignment from the Shipped bundle rows (OPS-226, OPS-229).
